entries.8c4712c411df49d8: Its basic policy is to aim, as a general trading company centered on the leisure industry, to create new demand and improve functionality while responding to changes in the environment. As its medium-term vision, it sets out “Building a Foundation for Sustainable Growth through New Product Development Schemes × Branding Communication × Growth Investment,” and states that it will work on expanding sales channels and services, strengthening product competitiveness through product planning and branding, developing human resources and organizational systems, and investing for growth.
entries.8e39a93d74452418: Since acquiring its regional businesses as subsidiaries in 2012, the company has operated with regional sales companies that work closely with the tourist destinations in their local areas. Working with local food manufacturers and regional organizations, it promotes local production for local consumption through processed products made from regional specialties and local products.
